summary.headline: Planetary Trines and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary trines and aspects, especially Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars with the Moon, Sun, Venus, Mercury, and Jupiter. The configurations signify rulership, wealth, honor, marriage, military command, public speaking, commerce, adultery, intelligence, and success according to lunar phase, nativity diurnality, angularity, and masculine or feminine signs.
